trust_decision.summary: Attacker-controlled request data placed in a log line by a token must be escaped so it cannot end the line; at the pinned commit only :remote-user is escaped (escapeLogField) and the escape set omits C1 controls and U+2028/U+2029.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'unescaped Unicode line separators'; the only escaping code is the escapeLogField character class, used by :remote-user (index.js:351), and HISTORY.md:6 says escaping is for :remote-user.

fix_sites.entry_point: any format string or format function using :remote-user (morgan(':remote-user', ...))
morgan.token('remote-user') used by the combined/common/default/short formats

public API morgan.token(name, fn); every built-in token (:url, :req[...], :res[...], :referrer, :user-agent, :method) and every user-defined token, reached by compiled format strings (compile, index.js:439-458) and by format functions calling tokens.* directly

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: index.js:587-590 (token() registry; the fix wraps every token here so function formats calling tokens.* are also covered, fix.diff:33-41)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and HISTORY.md:6 frame escaping as a :remote-user property; :url, :req[...] and :user-agent were never escaped, and function formats / custom tokens are user code, so a solver can argue only the regex in escapeLogField needs widening.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Escaping the whole line at the sink would strip the dev format's literal ANSI colour codes and break objectMode pass-through of objects; non-string token values (objects, numbers) must also pass through unchanged, and :remote-user must not be escaped twice (backslashes doubled) once the wrapper also escapes it.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: index.js:158-161 (sink, objectMode branch); index.js:233-234 (dev colour literals); fix.diff:39 (string-only escape); fix.diff:25-26 (removes the inner escape)

O6_input_shapes: C1 controls U+0080-U+009F incl. NEL U+0085
multi-value header arrays joined into one string (:req/:res, index.js:387-389, 404-406)
non-string token return values passed through
token values pulled from a function format rather than a compiled format string

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a dev-format variant that interpolates req.url or req.method directly instead of calling tokens.url/tokens.method
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dev format is registered through format(), not token(), and builds its own line; a maintainer optimising or adding colour per method could read req fields directly, skipping the token wrapper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a built-in structured/json format registered via format() that builds the object or string from req.headers directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: objectMode support (index.js:158-159) invites a built-in structured format; writing fields from req directly bypasses token() and its escaping.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a built-in token assigned by direct property write (morgan['x-forwarded-for'] = fn) rather than morgan.token()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: format() and token() both just set morgan[name]; a maintainer could assign directly, skipping the wrapper.

O9_family: CWE-117 log injection / output neutralisation (incomplete escape set + escape applied at one token only)

O10_build.project_tests: test/morgan.js :remote-user escaping tests (test/morgan.js:559-679); test/noColor.js for dev format; npm test (package.json:51)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Widen the escapeLogField regex to include \u0085/\u2028/\u2029 and stop, leaving :req[...], :url, :user-agent and function-format token calls unescaped.

out_of_scope_notes: Other invisible/bidi characters (e.g. U+202E, U+FEFF) are not escaped even after the fix; they do not end lines, so outside this advisory's property.
